scope: NON-GPU: actual Three 0.187.0 math, geometries and OrbitControls; mocked WebGLRenderer and 2D text measurement; synthetic DOM/events

groups.name: Initial scene, stable idle and ready notification
Independent orthographic equations and ray round trips
Actual generated room/sheet geometry is finite and contained
Normal-motion camera flight is interrupted by manual canvas input
Fast release commits a core-stable, contained point
Escape, pointer cancel, capture loss, blur and hidden restore exactly
Collisions, extreme corner targets and long frame gap remain contained

Context restore notifies the host ready again

Synthetic text measurements do not validate glyph sizing or legibility.
Synthetic pointer events do not establish real-browser hit targets.
